input: Сначала нужно измерить дополнительную задержку перевода и постобработки отдельно от распознавания речи. Для коротких сообщений желательно укладываться в полсекунды, а для длинных диктовок важно учитывать время генерации всего ответа. output: First, measure the additional translation and post-processing latency separately from speech recognition. For short messages, it is desirable to stay within half a second, while for long dictations, it is important to account for the time required to generate the entire response. If the model loads only after recording ends, its startup time will also be added to the latency. Therefore, the comparison must include performance on both the CPU and GPU, the first request and subsequent requests, as well as the handling of numbers, negations, names, and technical terms. Only after these experiments can a decision be made on whether to include both features in the application.
